observationsNotFindings: The containment is the tightest of any artifact in this sweep, and it needs to be, because this file's content is the text of an act that would move required-now from 26 to 27. Every occurrence of 27 and 31 in the entire file sits inside threeLimbActIfRecorded; not one escapes into an assertion about live state. Three conditional containers, a top-level thisFileExistingIsNotTheRecording flag, and four repetitions of 'This file existing is not' carry that discipline, and I confirmed the governed files were byte-identical before and after the review.

The single most important thing for the coordinator is a precondition the artifact states correctly and does not meet. It says dual independent ACCEPT 0/0 is required before any later D-000 appends a numbered heading, and none of its three inputs has a Codex counterpart - the naming candidate, the leftover join and the G31 specification are each Claude-only. Two of those three Claude verdicts are mine, written within the last hour. Recording this act today would therefore rest on a single reviewer's chain, which is exactly what the artifact's own precondition exists to prevent. The artifact is honest about this; the aggregate is only visible from the coordinator's position.

The proposed row resists the one temptation that would have been easy to miss. The v2 harness specification genuinely exists and is accepted, so a proposed file-08 row could plausibly have read authored. It reads 'not authored; not QUALIFIED', and threeLimbActIfRecorded.notAuthoredMeansNotQUALIFIED states the distinction outright - that the specification's existence is leftover-design authoring, not QUALIFIED. That keeps the naming half and the qualification half separate in the very object that would become the register row.

Even on recording, this act closes less than it might appear. eligibilityEffectIfRecorded holds that Gate 1 Class A is not opened, Class B SATISFIED is not recorded, and the DR-104 token stays DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED; what closes is the unnamed-remainder leftover, because a live gate would then own the execution. The execution itself remains qualification against eleven classes whose fixtures exist but have never been run.
